ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_ftb_geheimen1.des:
Find every secret, lost snuggly and puzzle in &dThe Snuggle Shrooms&r. Your &dExploration Book&r (B) keeps track of what you're still missing. Any character and any mode counts: once is enough.

&7Reward: a showpiece for your own world. You claim it at home, in the Guhmension or the normal world; inside The Chonkdom itself you can't.

ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_ftb_raid.desc:
Climb to the top of &dthe Stardousing Tower&r with your group, the raid of zone 6, and cheer up &dDuchess Ringaling&r. The first time counts. Any character and any mode counts: once is enough.

&7Reward: a showpiece for your own world. You claim it at home, in the Guhmension or the normal world; inside The Chonkdom itself you can't.

ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_ftb_rekruut.desc:
Find the collapsed order temple in the Guhmension and step through the portal. On &dSnuggle Camp&r Sergeant Fluffball teaches you the trade: finish your training by cheering up the Blob Giant. Any character and any mode counts: once is enough.

&7Reward: a showpiece for your own world. You claim it at home, in the Guhmension or the normal world; inside The Chonkdom itself you can't.
